name: OmaThock
author: TerrifiedBug
description: Mechanical keyboard sounds on every keypress. No input group, no binary, no installer: Hyprland's Lua event bus feeds a small Python mixer outside the shell. Plays thock, Mechvibes and MechvibesDX soundpacks unchanged.

barWidget.description: Mechanical keyboard sounds: toggle, soundpack, volume.

schema.label: Soundpack
schema.description: Directory name under soundpacks/ (bundled) or ~/.local/share/omathock/soundpacks/. thock, Mechvibes and MechvibesDX packs all work.
